header: Helpers for comparing and cleaning the readings of a page by two Gemini models (used by geminiOcr.ts). Pure: no I/O.

symbols.name: MIN_SHARED_WORDS
doc: The share of the checker's words that the primary's reading must also have. Below it, I take the two readings as not being of the same page.

members.name: primary
doc: The number as the primary reading has it.

members.name: checker
doc: The nearest number the checker's reading has instead (one or two digits away).

members.name: context
doc: The words around the checker's number.

symbols.name: cleanSecondReading
doc: Turns a reading into text for search: I remove the bare marks of things that are not text, while legible text on a stamp, handwriting and [illegible] stay.

symbols.name: distance
symbols.sig: function distance(a: string, b: string): number

symbols.name: pairDisputes
symbols.sig: export function pairDisputes(onlyPrimary: string[], onlyChecker: string[], primaryText: string, checkerText: string): Dispute[]
doc: Pairs each important number only the primary had with the nearest important number only the checker had (at most two digits away): "215000" and "15000".
